rv.q: This nostalgia act..is an excuse for talking, reminiscing, analysing. … is thoughtful, often pretty funny, not quite as substantial as it wants to be, but done with enough panache that the time goes quickly all the same. … What makes something funny? And what makes a comedian?
The Last Laugh is a gently funny, affectionate, poignant show, and as comfortable to watch as putting on your favourite slippers.
It might be easy for some to dismiss a show of this nature as an unnecessary venture into an era that has gone and will not return.
